landing.title: Daily Sadhana
landing.subtitle: Transform your daily spiritual practice into a consistent journey of devotion.
landing.offeredAtLotusFeet: Offered at the lotus feet of Srila Gurudev
landing.reason1Body: Record your Mangala Arati, Bhog offering, Granth reading, Harikatha and Mala in one gentle daily ritual.
landing.reason2Body: Watch your streak grow day by day, and let steady practice become second nature.
landing.reason3Body: A quiet moment of self-assessment after each day's Sadhana, offered with honesty.
landing.reason4Body: See your journey unfold through peaceful charts and a traditional Sadhana chart, digitized.
landing.footerText: A digital Sadhana journal, offered in the guidance of Srila Bhakti Vedant Sridhar Goswami Maharaj.
landing.footerCopyright: All glories to Sri Guru and Gauranga.
landing.heroHeadline: A Journey of Sadhna, Seva & Smaran
landing.heroSubhead: A sacred space to record, reflect upon, and deepen your daily connection with Krishna.
landing.thakurBody: Before the day's duties begin, a moment of Smaran — a quiet remembrance of Krishna. Bhajan opens the heart, Seva steadies the hands, and daily discipline turns devotion into a way of life. This is where gratitude finds its home.
landing.dailySadhnaSubtitle: Each page of your journal, gathered in one sacred place.
landing.cardMalaDesc: Rounds of the holy name, chanted with attention.
landing.cardBhajanDesc: Kirtan that carries the heart toward Krishna.
landing.cardKathaDesc: Hearing the pastimes and teachings of the Lord.
landing.cardTulsiDesc: Watering, care, and reverence for Srimati Tulsi.
landing.cardAartiDesc: Offering light at Mangala and through the day.
landing.cardReadingDesc: A few pages of Granth, absorbed slowly.
landing.cardSevaDesc: Small acts of service offered without expectation.
landing.cardReflectionsDesc: A quiet note on how the day was spent.
landing.journeySubtitle: Not numbers to chase — a gentle record of return, day after day.
landing.journeyStreakDesc: Days of returning, one after another.
landing.journeySevaDesc: Service offered with a quiet heart.
landing.journeyKathaDesc: Time spent in the Lord's pastimes.
landing.journeyDaysDesc: The whole of your journey, held gently.
landing.quoteText: Where remembrance becomes a habit, Sadhna becomes a way of life.
landing.footerTagline: An eternal journey of Sadhna, Seva & Smaran.
landing.footerClosing: All glories to Sri Guru and Gauranga.
